clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 纽森急阻亿万富翁税提案 最后一周斡旋 加州预算面临考验
title_lines: 最后一周斡旋 预算面临考验

subtitles.en: California Governor Gavin Newsom is mounting a last ditch pressure campaign to stop a proposed billionaire attacks from ever-reaching voters.
subtitles.zh: 加州州长纽森正发起最后施压，阻止一项针对亿万富翁的税收提案进入投票环节。

subtitles.en: Here now to report on that story is Bloomberg's Eliahu Kamasher in San Francisco.
subtitles.zh: 以下是彭博社记者埃利亚胡·卡马舍在旧金山的报道。

subtitles.en: So Eliahu, Gavin Newsom is trying to get this measure pulled before a June 25 deadline.
subtitles.zh: 埃利亚胡，纽森试图在6月25日截止前撤回这项提案。

subtitles.en: What is he offering? What kind of deal would it take to convince the union to walk away?
subtitles.zh: 他提出了什么条件？需要怎样的协议才能让工会放弃？
en_highlights: convince the union to walk away

subtitles.en: Yeah, he has just a week now to get this ballot measure off the ballot.
subtitles.zh: 他只剩一周时间将这项提案从选票中移除。
en_highlights: get this ballot measure off the ballot

subtitles.en: Any likely deal would probably involve steering some state budget funds to health care, but it's really unclear the billionaire attacks is trying to raise tens of billions of dollars
subtitles.zh: 可能的协议会涉及将部分州预算资金用于医疗，但亿万富翁税旨在筹集数百亿美元，以弥补联邦医疗削减。

subtitles.en: to backfill federal spending cuts from HR1 to the health care system.
subtitles.zh: 用于弥补HR1法案对医疗系统的联邦支出削减。

subtitles.en: And there's nothing in the state budget that could really come close to that.
subtitles.zh: 州预算中没有任何资金能接近这个数额。

subtitles.en: So there's a lot in the air right now about what a possible deal could look like to prevent this from going to the ballot in November.
subtitles.zh: 因此，目前关于如何阻止该提案在11月进入投票环节的协议方案仍悬而未决。

subtitles.en: Okay, so the health care union is backing this particular measure.
subtitles.zh: 好的，所以医疗工会支持这项提案。

subtitles.en: The opposition coalition is very unusual. You point out that it includes Gavin Newsom, the governor, billionaires, planned parenthood, teachers, carpenters, and Republican donors like Peter Teal.
subtitles.zh: 反对联盟非常不寻常，包括州长纽森、亿万富翁、计划生育协会、教师、木匠以及彼得·蒂尔等共和党捐赠者。

subtitles.en: I mean, that's an interesting group. What brings them all together?
subtitles.zh: 这是个有趣的组合，是什么让他们走到一起？

subtitles.en: It's a pretty remarkable group of people. You have billionaires.
subtitles.zh: 这群人相当引人注目，其中有亿万富翁。

subtitles.en: You have unions representing teachers and carpenters.
subtitles.zh: 还有代表教师和木匠的工会。

subtitles.en: And obviously, the California affiliate of planned parenthood.
subtitles.zh: 当然，还有加州计划生育协会。

subtitles.en: On the billionaire side, this is going to mean a huge tax bill for them.
subtitles.zh: 对亿万富翁来说，这意味着巨额税单。
